sentences.text: No; for a floating-rate loan sanctioned on or after 1 January 2026 to an individual for a purpose other than business, a UCB shall not levy pre-payment charges. [type=fact]
The bank’s own loan documents show a pre-payment charge of 2% in one version and 3% in another, but those clauses conflict with the applicable RBI direction for this case. [type=conflict]
The older 2025 pre-payment-charges direction and the 2014 floating-rate term-loan circular are no longer in force on the as-of date. [type=chain]
